name: dropdown-menu-41
description: Security settings list of signed-in devices, each with a menu to rename or revoke the session.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { InfoIcon, LaptopIcon, LogOutIcon, MoreHorizontalIcon, SmartphoneIcon, TabletIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" const initialSessions = [ { id: "a", device: "MacBook Pro · Safari", place: "Lisbon, PT", current: true, icon: LaptopIcon, }, { id: "b", device: "Pixel 9 · Chrome", place: "Porto, PT", current: false, icon: SmartphoneIcon, }, { id: "c", device: "iPad Air · App", place: "Madrid, ES", current: false, icon: TabletIcon, }, ] export default function ActiveSessionsMenu() { const [sessions, setSessions] = React.useState(initialSessions) return (
{sessions.map((s) => (

{s.device}

{s.place} · {s.current ? "This device" : "Active 3 days ago"}

} > View details setSessions((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== s.id)) } > Sign out device
))}
) }
